en.text:
Weapon Kills grant a Stack of Rampage. Maximum of 3 Stacks. Stacks expire one at a time every #e${4.5+#d} seconds.

Grants a 10%|21%|33.1% damage increase at 1|2|3 Stacks.

Weapon Kills trigger a solar elemental explosion, dealing up to <pve 109 /> <pvp [72.8] /> damage in a 3 meter radius.
